name: Knowledge published state
description: Checks that knowledge_id = 101 (KB-0000101) for product 67 (Microsoft SQL Server 2019 Patchset 47) is now in published state.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 101 AND product_id = 67 AND state = 'published';

name: Case Knowledge linkage
description: Ensures that KB 101 is linked to case 26 and marked as used_as = 'applied'.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_id = 26 AND knowledge_id = 101 AND used_as = 'applied';

name: Confirm User Membership
description: Confirms that Randy Martinez (user_id 37) is a member of the Knowledge Curation support group (group_id 13).

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_group_member WHERE group_id = 13 AND user_id = 37;

name: Case assigned to the user
description: Verifies that case 26 is assigned to group 13 (Knowledge Curation), owned by user 37 (Randy), and is in 'in_progress' state.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 26 AND assignment_group_id = 13 AND assigned_to = 37 AND state = 'in_progress';
